reason: Observability only — every unprompted turn (a reminder firing, a gathering notice, a compute result, a relay, a version announcement) now produces one named trace carrying its own outcome, where previously only participation turns did and the rest produced rootless, unnamed traces. Nothing a person in a room can see changes; it is the operator's ability to tell a reminder that failed from one that never happened.
summary: Internal: fire-path turns other than participation now produce a rooted, named trace.
